Shakespeare uses storms as symbols (Greenblatt 45). Later critics agree (Bloom and Hart 102-110; Garber 12). The play was popular (Figure 2). A missing source is cited (Nobody 7).

Works Cited

Bloom, Harold, and Lisa Hart. Shakespeare Today. Riverhead, 1998.
Garber, Marjorie. Shakespeare After All. Pantheon, 2004.
Greenblatt, Stephen. Will in the World. Norton, 2004.
Unused, Author. A Book Nobody Cited. Press, 2000.
